params.caption: Tan oling, siz ham "Let's discuss about it" deb yozganmisiz? Bu juda ko'p uchraydigan xato, chunki o'zbekchada "nima haqida gaplashamiz" deymiz va "haqida" so'zi "about" bo'lib chiqadi. Lekin discuss fe'lining o'zida "haqida" ma'nosi bor, ya'ni muhokama qilmoq. Shuning uchun undan keyin to'g'ridan-to'g'ri mavzu keladi: Let's discuss your IELTS plan, keling, IELTS rejangizni muhokama qilamiz. We discussed the problem with our teacher, muammoni o'qituvchimiz bilan muhokama qildik. They discussed how to prepare for the exam, ular imtihonga qanday tayyorlanishni muhokama qilishdi. "About" ishlatgingiz kelsa, ot shaklini oling: We had a discussion about the problem ham to'g'ri. Yoki oddiygina talk about deng. IELTS Writing'da "discuss about" yozilsa, bu grammatik xato sifatida baholanadi, shuning uchun essayni tekshirganda shu so'zga alohida qarang 🙂 📌 https://registan.edutizim.uz/order/entry/?survey=s33 📞 +998935512700 📱 Follow us on social media: 📱Telegram 📱Instagram 📱Location
